annotations.title: Search premium domains for sale on HugeDomains

description: Search the HugeDomains.com catalog of premium aftermarket domain names for sale by keyword, with optional TLD, USD price range and name-length filters. Returns a fixed-size page of listings, each with a USD buy-it-now price and a purchaseUrl, plus a `next` cursor for the following page (a limited number of pages per query). Use when a person wants domain ideas or options for a business, product, brand or topic (e.g. "short .com domains about coffee under $3000"). An empty list means nothing matched. Results are existing registered domains being resold, not new registrations.

maxLength.description: Maximum length of the name without the TLD

minLength.description: Minimum length of the name without the TLD

next.description: Cursor from a previous result to fetch the next page

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for, e.g. "coffee shop" or "fintech"

tld.description: TLDs to include, e.g. ["com", "net"]. Omit for all supported TLDs.

name: search_aftermarket_domains_for_sale
